title: Riverside, Punggol
provenance: Acquired by the late Dato' R. Sivanathan in 1952 and sold to the estate of Khadijah Binti Abdullah in 1985, passed down to her son, Amir Hassan Ali, in 2001, before being donated to the private collection of Jafar bin Ismail in 2010.
previous_owner: Collection of the late Dato' R. Sivanathan
